# David Gerbino — dmgerbino.com

> David Gerbino builds fintech data products with AI-assisted development and
> publishes recurring research on DMARC email authentication adoption, AI
> answer engine visibility (GEO), and search visibility (SEO) across banks,
> credit unions, and neobanks.

David Gerbino builds fintech data products solo, shipping on nights and
weekends with AI-assisted development. His research program tracks how U.S.
financial institutions — banks, credit unions, and neobanks — show up in
email authentication (DMARC), AI answer engines (GEO), and search (SEO), and
includes a monthly BLS unemployment data visualization project. He writes
about banking data (FFIEC call reports, NDFI exposure), fintech
infrastructure, and AI-augmented workflows.

## Projects

- [NDFI Tracker](https://ndfi-tracker.com): U.S. bank lending exposure tracker monitoring non-depository financial institution (NDFI) risk across 4,500+ banks using FFIEC call report data
- [Fintech Newsletters](https://fintechnewsletters.com): curated directory of fintech newsletters
- [How each was built](https://www.dmgerbino.com/projects): the tech stack and AI-assisted process behind each product

## Research

- [Research program](https://www.dmgerbino.com/research): recurring research, each project on its own cadence, published with methodology, sources, and underlying data
  - DMARC adoption across banks, credit unions, and neobanks
  - GEO — how AI answer engines represent financial institutions
  - SEO — search visibility companion series (planned)
  - U.S. unemployment, visualized — monthly BLS data project

## Writing

- [Writing index](https://www.dmgerbino.com/writing): essays on fintech, banking data, and AI
